papers.title: Generalized Cartan-Kac Matrices inspired from Calabi-Yau spaces
papers.abstract: The object of this work is the systematical study of a certain type of generalized Cartan matrices associated with the Dynkin diagrams that characterize Cartan-Lie and affine Kac-Moody algebras. These generalized matrices are associated to graphs which arise in the study and classification of Calabi-Yau spaces through Toric Geometry. We focus in the study of what should be considered the generalization of the affine exceptional series $E_{6,7,8}^{(1)}$ Kac-Moody matrices. It has been conjectured that these generalized simply laced graphs and associated link matrices may characterize generalizations of Cartan-Lie and affine Kac-Moody algebras.
